name: Elias Rios
home: the streets inland from Pier Beach
life: “I still remember quieting a guitar string with my dressing gown belt.” Saturday often includes a stop at the corner outside Coastal Barber, where Elias usually checks the board before the regulars give a more colorful account of the news.
voice: I play guitar on the ward. The old worker wanted a saucy song at a volume the child couldn't hear.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a long navy raincoat and a comb in a sleeve sewn into the lining. Elias has a long face and high cheekbones, with a center part and straight chestnut hair. Elias gathers both sleeves neatly before settling in during a conversation.
personality: Likes beautiful, unnecessary things and gets cross with people who mistake poverty for a lack of taste. Elias takes longer choosing a cheap birthday card than an expensive coat.
agenda: To play the private song at a considerate volume.
family: Marin Ramos is Elias’s older cousin. Elias gets to change the plan. Marin offers the first invitation. They learned that a promise to visit is easier to keep when changing a time does not count as letting down the whole family. Asked about *A sail cut small*, Marin says, “I sold the boat but kept its name. I didn't know I wanted the letter H until somebody made a hat of it.”
connections: Alexei Macrae. The guitarist and old nursing aide agree which jokes the young patient shouldn't have to overhear.
